heroSection.title: Evangelism & Discipleship
heroSection.description: Discipleship programs for children and youth aged 4–14, delivered within their local churches in partnership with synods and child-focused institutions.
heroSection.imageAlt: A teacher with two children holding their lesson booklets

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To win children and youth to Christ and support their spiritual growth through biblical courses delivered within their local churches, in partnership with local churches, synods, and child-focused institutions.
mission.imageAlt: Children raising their lesson booklets during a church gathering

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To train thousands of volunteer teachers and servants within their local churches—across Egypt and beyond—who will, in turn, disciple others and pass on a living faith to the next generation.
vision.imageAlt: Volunteer teachers holding their training certificates

evangelism.title: Evangelism
evangelism.description: We are committed to fulfilling the Great Commission by presenting the Lord Jesus Christ to children and youth around the world.

bible.title: The Holy Bible
bible.description: We are fully committed to the Bible as the foundation and primary source of all our teaching.

foundations.title: Foundations of Faith
foundations.description: Teaching children the core principles of the Christian faith.

discipleship.title: Discipleship
discipleship.description: Guiding and mentoring children and youth toward a genuine and growing relationship with the Lord Jesus Christ.

values.title: Biblical Values & Christian Living
values.description: Instilling biblical values and encouraging Christ-centered daily living.

programs.title: Our Programs
programs.description: Our discipleship curricula are biblically grounded, culturally relevant, and engaging, designed to answer children's spiritual questions and guide them into a growing relationship with Christ.
programs.note: The program consists of four age-based levels, covering ages 4–14, and is the first comprehensive Arabic discipleship curriculum for children and youth in the region.
programs.imageAltOne: Children holding their level booklets at a church meeting
programs.imageAltTwo: A hall full of children during a lesson

items.one: A training session for servants and teachers
items.two: Children and servants gathered in the church yard
items.three: A youth group with their pastor
items.four: Level completion certificates handed out to the children

mailbox.title: The Mailbox Club
mailbox.body: Through our extended discipleship pathway (ages 4–14), children grow steadily in their dependence on God's Word—through engaging, joyful, and meaningful learning experiences.

partners.synodAlt: Synod of the Nile Evangelical Church – Christian Education Council
